Subject: Vendor Enrollment: Redwood Inference — AP onboarding request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick signal that Redwood will be set up as a supplier for Axion. Attached is our standard vendor enrollment packet (PDF) and the minimal PO/invoice checklist we need for registration. Please complete the enrollment form and return with your preferred remit details, tax form (W-9 or equivalent), and a sample invoice for testing.

Key asks up front so we don't miss anything:
- Vendor legal name and Tax ID (TIN/GST/VAT) exactly as it should appear on invoices
- Bank remit instructions (ACH/IBAN + beneficiary name) and a remittance contact
- Default payment terms (we default to Net 45 unless otherwise agreed)
- Specify whether Redwood wants to opt into self-billing (we support self-bill for certain partners)

We can provision you in our supplier portal once we receive the completed form. If you'd rather us accept an early test invoice by SFTP/EDI, we can provision a test PO (see note below).

Attachments: Axion_Vendor_Enrollment_Form_20280625.pdf (fill & return)

Let me know if you'd like a short walkthrough call — happy to schedule.

Regards,
Carmen Diaz

4) Test flow: please confirm preferred ingestion method for the test invoice — SFTP drop, EDI/AS2, or email to ap-test@axioncorp.com?

From: Victor Huang <procurement@axioncorp.com>

On Tue, Jun 25, 2028 at 10:01 AM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Carmen — thanks, received. Looping in our Finance lead (Laura) and Ops (Marcus) to complete the packet. A couple quick clarifications so we return exactly what your team needs:

Hi Jonas — quick answers to your bullets below so you can prepare:

- PO mapping: yes, we require the PO number on the human-readable invoice PDF and as an XML element named "PO_NUM" in any e-invoice.
- Filename convention: prefer: <PO>-<SupplierName>-<InvoiceNumber>.pdf (e.g. AXN-PO-2028-778-Redwood-INV-001.pdf). Not strict but reduces manual reconciliation.
- VAT/TAX: we maintain a single supplier record per legal entity. If you have multiple legal entities with different tax registrations, please provide a separate enrollment for each entity.
- Test ingestion: SFTP preferred for e-invoice XMLs. We also accept a single test invoice by email to ap-test@axioncorp.com for quick verification.

Attached are:
- AXN-PO-2028-778.xml (sample test PO we can push to your test inbox)
- axion_einvoice_xsd_v3.2.pdf (XML schema + element naming)

A few policy notes:
- Default payment term is Net 45. If you need Net 30, we can request a payment term exception (may require a business justification).
- Self-billing: we can enable self-billing, but that requires an opt-in form and a signed MSA addendum — Carmen has the DocuSign link below.

DocuSign for opt-ins & any tax forms: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123xyz

We will provision a test PO and SFTP drop once we have the completed enrollment form and tax document in place.

Regards,
Victor Huang
Sourcing | Axion Corporation
procurement@axioncorp.com

Attachments: AXN-PO-2028-778.xml, axion_einvoice_xsd_v3.2.pdf

On Wed, Jun 26, 2028 at 10:40 AM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:
> One more question: does Axion require the invoice to include a PO line-level acknowledgment (unit price per PO line) or is a top-line total with PO reference sufficient?

Hi Jonas — top-line total with PO reference is acceptable for most software/invoice types. Line-level detail is only required when PO lines reference discrete deliverables or physical goods. For Redwood's standard monthly invoice for hosted inference usage a single total with PO reference will be fine.

We will:
- Provision the test PO AXN-PO-2028-778 in our sandbox this afternoon and push a sample XML to the SFTP test folder.
- Confirm SFTP hostname + preferred credential exchange via a separate secure ticket (we do not email passwords).
- Send a DocuSign confirmation once the self-bill envelope is complete: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123xyz

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Carmen will track the ticket and ping when the sandbox PO & SFTP are live.

Best,
Carmen Diaz
AP Onboarding | Axion Corporation
